notes.title: More Halloween veggies 🎃🍅👻
notes.content:
We’ve just added 3 new items for you to discover! 

Here’s the breakdown: 

a Common item with a 56% drop rate, 
a Rare item with a 34% drop rate
the Legendary item with a challenging 8% drop rate. 

Happy hunting, and may the odds be in your favor!

notes.title: Spooktacular Halloween Update at Greengrocer's! 👻☠🎃
notes.content:
Get ready for some Halloween fun! We’ve added 5 new items just in time for the spooky season. 

Here’s what you can expect:

Two Common Items with a drop chance of 56% every 15 minutes
Two Rare Items with a drop chance of 34% every hour
One Legendary Item with a drop chance of 8% every 2 hours
Remember, none of these items will be available in the store.

Stay tuned for more surprises! Additional items will be added on Wednesday, with the final batch arriving on Thursday. The game will return to its original form on Friday morning, after which all Halloween items will be available exclusively on the Steam Community Market.

Happy haunting!

notes.title: Update 5.0 Fixed bugs
notes.content:
We fixed bugs with some veggies. We also add more halloween veggies to the game. :) 

Have fun guys!

notes.title: New Veggies in Greengrocer's – 10 New items added! 👻🎃🍆

We're excited to announce the addition of 10 Halloween new vegetables to Greengrocer's! Come check out what we’ve prepared and enrich your game with these fresh, unique additions. 💚🍅

Don’t miss our special Halloween event! At midnight, you’ll have a chance to win exclusive items for one hour. Join us on our Discord to stay updated with the latest news and engage with the community. 

🥒 https://discord.com/invite/X3cN7zh9pf 

Join us in Greengrocer's – exciting surprises await you! 🎃👀

notes.title: 15 new vegetables to celebrate Halloween 🎃👻
notes.content:
Grow unique zombie vegetables and other scary creatures to celebrate Halloween at Greengrocer's! 🎃🍆

[b]You can even get dozens of unique items. 
[/b]

What's more, on Halloween at midnight FOR ONE HOUR you'll be able to get 10 LEGENDARY vegetables that will only be available then!

notes.title: Halloween Update 0.4 🎃🍆👻
notes.content:
More vegetables for Halloween and more fun. From now on, you can get an additional 10 items at Greengrocer's until November 1. 

After that time, they will be impossible to get.

notes.title: Halloween Update 3.0
notes.content:
Update 3.0 

To celebrate Halloween we have added: 

- 10 new vegetables you can get your hands on by 1 November 
- We have changed the frequency with which some vegetables appear
- Carrot, cabbage, potato, tomato, cucumber, courgette plantations have disappeared due to the progressive vegetable infestation. Others have been badly damaged, which means that you will meet these vegetables at the market much less frequently.

notes.title: New Halloween Update in Greengrocer's! 🎃👻☠
notes.content:
Another small update. 

8 new Halloween items have been added. 

The items will be discontinued after 1 November - after that they will not be available on Greengrocer's market.

notes.title: Halloween in Greengrocer's! 👻🎃 Update 2.0
notes.content:
We have made a number of changes. 

To celebrate Halloween, unique vegetables are available from now until 1 November. Even more will be added over time. 

After that, these vegetables will no longer be available on the market. 


The second thing: 

Halloween has led to a plague of vegetables in our vegetable store! As of now, the unavailable ones are: 

- tomatoes
- potatoes
- cucumbers 
- cabbages 

Other vegetables will come in less frequently.

notes.title: Game release delayed to 7 October!
notes.content:
Due to some technical problems and a lot of ongoing work, we have had to delay the launch once again - this time until 7 October. We hope to be able to release the game by that date.  

There will also soon be a dedicated Discord for the game, where we will discuss and plan the development of the game together, along with the items available on the market. :) 

In touch!
